title: Intermittent payment failures with HTTP 503
symptoms: Payment API returned 503 during peak traffic.
resolution: Connection-pool settings were reviewed and adjusted after confirming pool exhaustion.

title: Customer portal authentication timeout
symptoms: Login endpoint timed out for a subset of users.
resolution: Authentication service latency was identified from metrics and corrected.

title: Storage endpoint unavailable for uploads
symptoms: File upload calls failed when the storage endpoint was unreachable.
resolution: Connectivity was restored and the endpoint health check passed.
